description: Read, or add to, the customs data on a booked international order: incoterm, shipper / consignee, importer or exporter of record, commodities (HS / HTS / Schedule B codes, values, country of origin), ITN, ISF. Omit update to read what is saved. Pass update to merge those fields in; the forwarder is notified, invalid optional values come back in warnings, and sanctioned parties are rejected. Auth required.

update.description: Fields to merge, in gw's internationalInfo shape
